subject.description: VID of the party whose role is changing.

fromRole.description: Role the subject is moving from. MUST equal payload.before.role.

toRole.description: Role the subject is moving to. MUST equal payload.after.role.

before.description: The AclEntry as it existed before this role change.

after.description: The AclEntry as it exists after the maintainer accepts this role change. MUST differ from `before` only in `role`, `updatedAt`, and `updatedBy`.

Response.title: ACL Change Role — response payload
Response.description: The success response to an acl/change-role request. Carried in a Trust Task document whose type is https://trusttasks.org/spec/acl/change-role/1.0#response.

entry.description: The AclEntry that the maintainer now holds for the subject. MUST equal the request's payload.after.
